title: SP Classify: an active-learning cell classifier extension for QuPath
description:
A QuPath extension for classifying cells in highly multiplexed images. It trains two different gradient-boosted models on manually labelled cells, then uses their disagreement to pick the most informative cells for you to review next, so a usable classifier can be built from a few hundred labels rather than thousands.

Also includes marker-based gating, composite multi-marker rules, project-wide clustering (k-means and Leiden), cellular-neighborhood analysis, intensity heatmaps, spatial distance measurements and whole-image QC.

Provides similar functionality to parts of CellTune by the Keren Lab. If you use this tool, please also cite the CellTune paper (doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03162-2).
